details:
SPACE TYCOONS: Survive, Save & Expand

Space Tycoons is an interactive STEM simulation that bridges the critical gap between aerospace engineering and financial literacy. Unlike traditional educational games where players simply maximize technology to win, this project forces students to make critical engineering decisions under strict, realistic economic constraints.

Players act as Mission Directors tasked with establishing a Lunar or Martian outpost. They must constantly manage vital life-support systems—Oxygen, Food, and Energy—which rapidly decay due to the hostile environments. However, every infrastructure upgrade costs money, and prices inflate exponentially.

The defining mechanic of the simulation is the Emergency Reserve Fund. Players are subjected to a mandatory, locked capital reserve (20% to 40% of their starting funds, depending on the planet's difficulty). If a player overspends to maintain their vitals and breaches this reserve floor, they face severe penalties. This teaches the core philosophy of the game: Survival is mandatory, spending is strategic, and savings determine the champion.

To ensure deep authenticity, the application integrates live NASA APIs:

  • DONKI Space Weather: Triggers unpredictable energy crises via real-time Coronal Mass Ejection (solar storm) data.
  • NTRS/OSDR: Contextualizes space agriculture and hydroponics with real NASA open-source data.
  • NASA Image Library: Injects authentic, dynamic satellite telemetry of the Lunar and Martian surfaces directly into the UI.

Built as a highly accessible, zero-dependency HTML5 application, Space Tycoons features a high-performance "mission control" CSS Grid interface, an interactive AI companion (NOVA), and real-time visual analytics. It successfully delivers a high-stakes, consequence-driven learning environment where students experience firsthand how real space exploration requires balancing human survival with limited financial resources.
